source.book: 《资治通鉴》卷九十三《晋纪十五》
source.excerpt: 生无益于时，死无闻于后，是自弃也！”诸参佐或以谈戏废事者，命取其酒器、蒲博之具，悉投之于江，将吏则加鞭扑，曰：“樗蒲者，牧猪奴戏耳！老、庄浮华，非先王之法言，不益实用。君子当正其威仪，何有蓬头跣足，自谓宏达耶！”有奉馈者，必问其所由，若力作所致，虽微必喜，慰赐参倍；若非理得之，则切厉诃辱，还其所馈。尝出游，见人持一把未熟稻，侃问：“用此何为？”人云：“行道所见，聊取之耳。”侃大怒曰：“汝既不佃，而戏贼人稻！”执而鞭之。是以百姓勤于农作，家给人足。尝造船，其木屑竹头，侃皆令籍而掌之，人咸不解所以。后正会，积雪始晴，听事前馀雪犹湿，乃以木屑布地。及桓温伐蜀，又以侃所贮竹头作丁装船。其综理微密，皆此类也。
source.transcriptionNote: 复用现有已录入批次的逐字原文快照；底本定位、原件哈希及行号保留。电子本尚不宣称纸本异文全校。

panels.title: 造船的余料
panels.caption: 工匠造船，留下一些木屑和竹头。
panels.scene: Ancient riverside shipyard, wooden hull under construction, workers with hand tools and visible piles of curled wood shavings and bamboo offcuts.

panels.title: 都登记收好
panels.caption: 陶侃吩咐，把这些余料登记下来，妥善保管。
panels.scene: Blue-robed Tao Kan gestures to separate baskets of wood shavings and bamboo offcuts; clerk holds blank bamboo slips.

panels.title: 旁人不明白
panels.caption: 大家不理解：这些不起眼的东西，何必特意收藏？
panels.scene: Workers look curiously at carefully stored baskets in a simple warehouse, one scratches head, Tao Kan calm nearby.

panels.title: 雪后地面湿滑
panels.caption: 后来一次正月聚会前，积雪刚化，厅前地面还很湿。
panels.scene: Later winter courtyard with patchy melting snow and wet walkway leading to official hall, guests pause at slippery entrance.

evidence.excerpt: 后正会，积雪始晴，听事前馀雪犹湿

panels.title: 木屑派上用场
panels.caption: 陶侃让人把存下的木屑铺在地上。
panels.scene: Workers spread curled wood shavings from the stored baskets onto wet courtyard walkway while Tao Kan watches.

panels.title: 竹头也留着
panels.caption: 那些竹头没有被丢弃，继续保存在库里。
panels.scene: Quiet warehouse still life: well-kept baskets of short bamboo offcuts, remaining wood shavings to one side; no readable labels or dates.

panels.title: 又过了些时候
panels.caption: 等到后来桓温伐蜀，陶侃存下的竹头又被拿了出来。
panels.scene: Much later shipyard with rust-robed Huan Wen and workers receiving aged baskets of bamboo offcuts. Tao Kan is ABSENT. No fantastical time transition symbols.

panels.title: 做成船钉
panels.caption: 这些竹头做成了装船的钉子。原先不起眼的余料，终于又有了用处。
panels.scene: Close view of craftsman shaping bamboo peg and fitting it into a timber joint on a boat, basket of bamboo offcuts nearby, no metal modern nails.

evidence.excerpt: 又以侃所贮竹头作丁装船

adaptations: 用“后来”分开木屑铺地与桓温装船，不强写为同年同日。
陶侃不出现在桓温伐蜀现场；竹钉形制为示意，不冒充出土复原图。

checks: 逐格核对情节、人物与关键道具
直接参考用户选定的徙木立信：夸张造型、简练黑线、平涂色块
无嵌入正文，无虚构结果
imageReview.notes: 局部修正最后一格为细实心竹钉，未将粗空心竹管直接当钉；陶侃不出现在桓温后来的造船场景。 已完成本轮画风统一并复查。

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua story atlas, exactly 8 sequential illustrations on ONE image. Primary request: 陶侃收藏木屑竹头. Composition: STRICT equal rectangular grid of TWO columns and 4 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. All row heights equal, all column widths equal. Canvas target 1024 x 1280. Narrow straight cream gutters, maximum 4 pixels; no outer margin, no header/footer; every scene fills its own complete LANDSCAPE cell. No merged panels, insets, or changes in layout.
Style: classic 1950s-1960s Chinese small-picture storybook, early Shanghai Animation folk-art sensibility. Graceful expressive fine ink outlines, hand-painted gouache, mineral blue/green, muted cinnabar and ochre, textured warm cream paper, restrained humor and human facial expressions. Rich but legible environments; varied wide/medium/close shots. NOT modern anime, 3D, glossy or photorealistic. Ancient China, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, calligraphy, watermark or symbols that look like writing ANYWHERE. Clothing and face continuity within the atlas is essential.
Characters and invariants: Tao Kan: mature capable official with long dark beard, deep blue robe and simple black Jin official cap. Workers in ochre and brown tunics. Later Huan Wen: younger-middle-aged commander with dark beard, rust-red robe and simple Jin military cap. No modern tools. Wood shavings look like thin curled sawdust; bamboo offcuts are short thick hollow tan cylinders, later made into pegs. Tao Kan appears only in collection and snow scenes, NOT in the much later Huan Wen scene.
Scenes in this exact order:
1. Ancient riverside shipyard, wooden hull under construction, workers with hand tools and visible piles of curled wood shavings and bamboo offcuts.
2. Blue-robed Tao Kan gestures to separate baskets of wood shavings and bamboo offcuts; clerk holds blank bamboo slips.
3. Workers look curiously at carefully stored baskets in a simple warehouse, one scratches head, Tao Kan calm nearby.
4. Later winter courtyard with patchy melting snow and wet walkway leading to official hall, guests pause at slippery entrance.
5. Workers spread curled wood shavings from the stored baskets onto wet courtyard walkway while Tao Kan watches.
6. Quiet warehouse still life: well-kept baskets of short bamboo offcuts, remaining wood shavings to one side; no readable labels or dates.
7. Much later shipyard with rust-robed Huan Wen and workers receiving aged baskets of bamboo offcuts. Tao Kan is ABSENT. No fantastical time transition symbols.
8. Close view of craftsman shaping bamboo peg and fitting it into a timber joint on a boat, basket of bamboo offcuts nearby, no metal modern nails.

styleRefinement.instructions: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle ONLY IMAGE 1, the edit target. IMAGE 2 (approved older 移木立信 artwork) is the PRIMARY style reference; IMAGE 3 (newly corrected fish-refusal artwork) is a SECONDARY reference for the same approved style. Do not import reference story events, characters, sword/pole/fish props, captions or text. Draw the target in the same artistic language as images 2 and 3: strongly designed Chinese folk/early Shanghai animation characters, larger expressive heads, compact stylized adult bodies, angular expressive eyebrows and noses made with very few confident strokes, small curved eyes, humorous expressive poses, fluid varied BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte pigment blocks with only spare broad ink-wash texture. Reduce realistic anatomy, skin modeling, facial shading, brocade patterns, tiny clothing folds and detailed background rendering dramatically. Robes are mostly solid muted color fields with spare trim, NO all-over elaborate embroidery. Simplify background buildings into rhythmic geometric silhouettes, light ink washes and warm UNPAINTED cream space. Restrained indigo, ochre and cinnabar, subtle paper grain like image 2, no dense brown texture overlay. NOT realistic illustrated portraiture, glossy painting, modern anime, chibi toys, 3D or photorealism. Keep all characters ADULT unless explicitly elderly. Preserve each character's consistent identifying robe color, beard and role, but redraw their form in this stylized way. No words, numerals, letters, title, captions, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermark or readable marks ANYWHERE, including on documents, garments or props. Ignore all text visible in the style reference. Do not add a header or footer.
